  launchctl print "gui/$UID/$L" 2>&1 | rg -n 'state =|path =|program =|pid =|last exit|runs =|label =|ProgramArguments|StartCalendar|StartInterval|Throttle|KeepAlive|disabled' | head -40
done
echo; echo "=== plist Program/WorkingDirectory ==="; for f in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.{dc,youchu}*.plist; do
  echo "==== $(basename "$f") ===="
  /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :Label' "$f" 2>/dev/null

  echo
done

# Inspect vpn launchd env loading + App Support launcher
echo "=== vpn App Support ==="; cat ~/Library/Application\ Support/vpn-sync/run.sh; echo; head -80 ~/.dc-platform/scripts/install-vpn-sync-launchd.sh; echo; echo "=== does python load .env? ==="; rg -n 'vpn_ovpn_sync\.env|load_dotenv|VPN_OVPN_DIR' ~/.dc-platform/scripts/vpn_ovpn_sync.py | head -30

# Clean clear runtime redundancy
set -e
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
# 1) ensure old dual label not loaded, remove orphan plist
launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/com.youchu.tgbot-dc" 2>/dev/null || true
if [[ -f "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.tgbot-dc.plist" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac/archive-orphan"
  mv "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.tgbot-dc.plist" "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac/archive-orphan/com.youchu.tgbot-dc.plist.$(date +%Y%m%d)"
  echo "moved orphan com.youchu.tgbot-dc.plist -> archive-orphan"
fi
# 2) clear stale pid files
for f in \
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/daemon-bg.pid" \
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/tg-group-feed-bridge.pid"
do
  if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
    pid=$(tr -d '[:space:]' <"$f")
    if [[ -n "$pid" ]] && ! ps -p "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      rm -f "$f"
      echo "removed stale pid $f ($pid)"
    fi
  fi
done
# 3) archive ancient disabled-on-new-mac copies that conflict with live labels (keep one archive)
ARCH="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac"
if [[ -d "$ARCH" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$ARCH/archive-202607"
  for f in com.dc.tgbot-daemon.plist com.youchu.agent-bus-poller.plist com.youchu.tgbot-dc.plist com.youchu.vpn-sync.plist; do
    if [[ -f "$ARCH/$f" ]]; then
      mv "$ARCH/$f" "$ARCH/archive-202607/$f"
      echo "archived stale backup $f"
    fi
  done
fi
echo "=== LaunchAgents now ==="; ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist 2>/dev/null; echo; ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac/ 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== live labels ==="; launchctl list | rg 'youchu|dc\.tgbot'
input.description: Remove orphan plist and stale PIDs

content.text:
本机是 **new-mac 权威机**（`AUTHORITY_HOST=new-mac`），无 crontab，自动化全靠 LaunchAgents。

## 现网必留（10 个）

| Label | 类型 | 状态 | 作用 |
|-------|------|------|------|
| `com.dc.tgbot-daemon` | 常驻 | running | TG bot（App Support runtime） |
| `com.youchu.agent-bus-poller` | 常驻 | running | agent-bus 轮询 + wake-bridge |
| `com.youchu.onehr-checkin` | 常驻 | running | OneHR 打卡调度 |
| `com.youchu.ethan-jobs-watch` | 常驻 | running | Ethan 频道大数据岗位监听 |
| `com.youchu.vpn-sync` | 每 30min | 间隔空闲 OK | VPN `.ovpn` 续期 |
| `com.youchu.memory-git-sync` | 每 2min | 间隔空闲 OK | memory git 同步 |
| `com.youchu.chcode-git-sync` | 每天 08:30 | 定时 | CHcode `git pull` |
| `com.youchu.pre-daily-report-flush` | 工作日 21:20 / 六 18:20 | 定时 | 日报前 flush |
| `com.youchu.daily-report-wake` | 工作日 21:30 / 六 18:30 | 定时 | 日报 wake |
| `com.youchu.daily-report-fallback` | +15min | 定时 | 日报兜底 |

**故意不开**：`cursor-executor`（`AGENT_BUS_CURSOR_AUTO_EXECUTE=false`）、`tg-group-feed-bridge`、`com.youchu.vpn-watch`、`memory-peer-sync`。

---

## 已清理的冗余

1. **双 bot 孤儿 plist**：`com.youchu.tgbot-dc.plist`（未加载，与 `com.dc.tgbot-daemon` 争同一 start 脚本）→ 移到 `~/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac/archive-orphan/`
2. **过期 pid**：`daemon-bg.pid`、`tg-group-feed-bridge.pid`（进程已死）→ 已删
3. **迁机前旧备份**（2026-07）：`disabled-on-new-mac/*.plist` → 收入 `archive-202607/`，避免再被误 bootstrap

---

## 建议再砍（先确认再动）

| 项 | 说明 |
|----|------|
| `disabled-on-new-mac/archive-*` | 整目录硬删（已归档，可再留几天） |
| `.cursor/scripts/vpn-sync-now-old-mac.sh` | 名带 old-mac，功能仍是手动 VPN；可改名或删 |
| `~/.dc-platform/scripts/fill-oldmac-memory-pull.sh` | old-mac 拉记忆，权威已在本机 |
| `install-vpn-watch-launchd.sh` | 从未装上；现已有 telethon 版 `vpn-sync` |
| `com.youchu.ethan-jobs-watch` | 若不再盯 Ethan 岗位可 unload |
| App Support ↔ `.cursor/scripts` 脚本漂移 | 跑一次 `sync-agent-bus-deploy.sh` 对齐（非删，是同步） |

---

## 顺带健康备注（非冗余）

- **OneHR**：今早截图因辅助功能未授给 launchd 下的 `python3.14` 失败；日志已记「手动打卡已确认」。下班窗前把 Accessibility 勾上即可。
- **VPN**：当前 `--check` 已是 `auto_vpn`；今日 10:03 日志里还曾出现 `onehr` 路径，应是改配置前的一次跑。
- **agent-bus**：有一批历史「processed 无 reply」未结案（bootstrap 里那串），与本次清理无关。

要我接着做哪几项？回复例如：`硬删 archive` / `卸 ethan` / `删 old-mac 脚本` / `跑 sync-agent-bus-deploy`。
